# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the Zod schemas. Do not edit by hand. -->

Cutline exposes 33 tools. All times are in **seconds**. Every tool returns a one-line
summary plus compact JSON (also as `structuredContent`); errors carry a code and a hint that
says how to fix the call. `projectId` is optional everywhere: it defaults to the project you
created or used most recently.

## Server instructions

Sent to the client on connect:

```text
Cutline is a video editor. The timeline is a JSON document that a human is watching live in a browser; every change you make appears there immediately (highlighted), and they may edit too.

How to work:
- All times are in seconds. Tracks are stacked bottom (index 0) to top. Clips never overlap on one track.
- Start with get_project (or create_project), then add_asset for media and add_clip to place it.
- Ids (clip_…, track_…, asset_…) come from tool results; call get_project again when unsure, since ranges and ids change after cuts.
- To remove silences: detect_silence, then delete_range with the returned ranges (it ripples all tracks so audio, video and captions stay in sync).
- To remove "um"/"uh"/"äh" fillers from speech: remove_filler_words (dryRun=true first to review).
- To cut to music: cut_to_beats lays the footage out so every cut lands on a beat (detect_beats shows tempo and beat times).
- To add subtitles: add_captions with fromTranscript=true (do this AFTER cutting, so captions match the final timing).
- For background music: duck_music lowers it under speech; normalize_loudness evens out clip levels (-14 LUFS by default).
- For on-brand graphics: set_brand_kit once (colors, fonts, logo), then add_template / add_text_overlay / add_shape use it by default; add_template with template "logo" places the logo.
- To check your work: get_frames (look at stills), get_waveform_summary, get_transcript.
- Finish with export_video (server-side MP4) and give the user the download URL.
- Everything is undoable (undo/redo), including the human's edits. apply_operations batches many edits into one undo step.
- Errors include a hint describing how to fix the call.
```

## Editing

### `create_project`

**Create project.** Create a new, empty video project (with tracks V1 and A1) and make it the active project. Returns the project id and the URL where the user can watch edits live.

| Parameter         | Type                   | Required | Description                        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `name`            | string                 | yes      | Project name                       |
| `width`           | integer (≥ 16, ≤ 7680) |          | Output width in px (default 1920)  |
| `height`          | integer (≥ 16, ≤ 4320) |          | Output height in px (default 1080) |
| `fps`             | number (≤ 240)         |          | Frame rate (default 30)            |
| `backgroundColor` | string                 |          | Color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA      |

### `get_project`

**Get project.** Read the timeline: tracks (bottom to top), clips with ids, timeline start/end and source in/out (seconds), assets and settings. Call this to find clip ids before editing. Without a projectId it uses the active project and also lists the other projects.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type    | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string  |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `full`      | boolean |          | Return the complete raw JSON document instead of the compact summary   |

### `add_asset`

**Add asset.** Import a media file (video, audio or image) into the project from an absolute local path on the server machine or from an http(s) URL. Returns the asset id plus duration, size and whether it has audio/video. Importing does not put anything on the timeline: use add_clip next.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `path`      | string |          | Absolute file path on the machine running the Cutline server           |
| `url`       | string |          | http(s) URL to download                                                |
| `name`      | string |          | Display name (default: file name)                                      |

### `add_clip`

**Add clip.** Place an asset on the timeline. Defaults: appended at the end of the first suitable track, using the whole asset (images: 5s). Video assets keep their audio on the same clip. Use clipType "audio" to place only the audio of a video. Returns the new clip id.

| Parameter     | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `assetId`     | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `trackId`     | string                                   |          | Target track (default: first suitable track with room, or a new one)                                             |
| `start`       | number (≥ 0)                             |          | Timeline position in seconds (default: end of the track)                                                         |
| `sourceStart` | number (≥ 0)                             |          | In-point within the asset in seconds (default 0)                                                                 |
| `duration`    | number                                   |          | Length in seconds (default: rest of the asset)                                                                   |
| `clipType`    | `"video"` \| `"audio"` \| `"image"`      |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`        | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |
| `volume`      | number (≥ 0, ≤ 4)                        |          | Linear gain, 1 = unchanged                                                                                       |
| `transform`   | object                                   |          | Position offset from center (px), scale, rotation (deg), opacity                                                 |

### `split_clip`

**Split clip.** Cut a clip in two at a timeline time (seconds). The left part keeps the id; the right part gets a new id (returned as newClipId).

| Parameter   | Type         | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string       |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string       | yes      |                                                                        |
| `time`      | number (≥ 0) | yes      | Timeline time of the cut                                               |

### `trim_clip`

**Trim clip.** Change where a clip starts and/or ends on the timeline. Moving the start also moves the source in-point (like dragging the clip edge in an editor). ripple=true shifts the following clips on the same track to keep the gap closed.

| Parameter   | Type         | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string       |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string       | yes      |                                                                        |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0) |          | New timeline start                                                     |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0) |          | New timeline end                                                       |
| `ripple`    | boolean      |          |                                                                        |

### `move_clip`

**Move clip.** Move a clip to a new timeline start, optionally onto another compatible track.

| Parameter   | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `clipId`    | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                             | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                  |
| `trackId`   | string                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`      | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |

### `delete_clip`

**Delete clips.** Delete one or more clips. ripple=true closes the gaps on their tracks. To cut a time range out of the whole timeline (all tracks), use delete_range instead.

_Annotations: destructive_

| Parameter   | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipIds`   | string[] | yes      |                                                                        |
| `ripple`    | boolean  |          |                                                                        |

### `delete_range`

**Delete time ranges.** Cut timeline ranges (seconds) out of all unlocked tracks at once, splitting clips as needed, and close the gaps (ripple) so video, audio and captions stay in sync. This is the tool for removing silences, filler or mistakes: pass the ranges from detect_silence or get_transcript directly. Ranges may be given in any order and may overlap.

_Annotations: destructive_

| Parameter   | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `ranges`    | object[] | yes      | Timeline ranges to remove, in the CURRENT timeline time                |
| `trackIds`  | string[] |          | Only these tracks (default: all unlocked tracks)                       |
| `ripple`    | boolean  |          | Close the gaps (default true)                                          |

### `remove_filler_words`

**Remove filler words.** Cut hesitation sounds ("um", "uh", "äh", "ähm", …) out of talking-head footage in one step. Transcribes the timeline audio (local Whisper, word timestamps, cached), finds the fillers and removes them with ONE delete_range (one undo step, ripples all unlocked tracks so audio, video and captions stay in sync). Matching ignores case and punctuation ("Um," matches). Default list: um, uh, uhm, uhh, er, erm, ah, hmm, hm, mhm, äh, ähm, öhm, öh. repeats=true also cuts stutters like "I I think". Use dryRun=true first to review what would be cut. Limitation: Whisper often omits disfluencies from its transcript, so fillers it did not write down cannot be found; pair with detect_silence for pauses.

_Annotations: destructive_

| Parameter   | Type                | Required | Description                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string              |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.    |
| `fillers`   | string[]            |          | Words to remove; replaces the default list (case/punctuation-insensitive) |
| `repeats`   | boolean             |          | Also cut immediate word repetitions such as "I I think" (default false)   |
| `padding`   | number (≥ 0, ≤ 0.5) |          | Seconds also cut around each filler, never into kept words (default 0.05) |
| `language`  | string              |          | Spoken language for transcription, e.g. "en", "de" (default: auto-detect) |
| `dryRun`    | boolean             |          | Only report what would be cut, change nothing (default false)             |

### `set_clip_property`

**Set clip properties.** Change clip properties: transform {x, y (px offset from center), scale, rotation (deg), opacity 0..1}, effects {brightness, contrast, saturation (-1..1), blur (px); null removes}, keyframes per property (clip-relative seconds; [] removes), fadeIn/fadeOut (s), volume/muted, text and style for text clips, words for captions, transitionIn, animationIn/animationOut ({preset, duration}; null removes; see animate_clip). Only the fields you pass are changed.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string | yes      |                                                                        |
| `props`     | object | yes      |                                                                        |

### `animate_clip`

**Animate clip in/out.** Give a visual clip (text, shape, image or video) an entrance ("in") and/or exit ("out") animation preset, without writing keyframes. Presets: "fade" (opacity), "slide-left" / "slide-right" / "slide-up" / "slide-down" (moves in that direction by a quarter of the frame while fading: slide-up enters from below and exits upward), "zoom" (scales from 50% while fading), "pop" (scales up from 30% with a small overshoot). The in animation plays over the first `duration` seconds of the clip, the out animation over the last; they follow the clip when it is trimmed or split and combine with its transform and keyframes. "none" removes an animation.

| Parameter     | Type                                                                                                               | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string                                                                                                             |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`      | string                                                                                                             | yes      |                                                                        |
| `in`          | `"fade"` \| `"slide-left"` \| `"slide-right"` \| `"slide-up"` \| `"slide-down"` \| `"zoom"` \| `"pop"` \| `"none"` |          | Entrance preset, or "none" to remove                                   |
| `out`         | `"fade"` \| `"slide-left"` \| `"slide-right"` \| `"slide-up"` \| `"slide-down"` \| `"zoom"` \| `"pop"` \| `"none"` |          | Exit preset, or "none" to remove                                       |
| `duration`    | number (≤ 10)                                                                                                      |          | Seconds for both animations (default 0.5, max 10)                      |
| `inDuration`  | number (≤ 10)                                                                                                      |          | Seconds for the entrance (overrides duration)                          |
| `outDuration` | number (≤ 10)                                                                                                      |          | Seconds for the exit (overrides duration)                              |

### `add_text_overlay`

**Add text overlay.** Add a text title/overlay. By default it is centered on screen on a text track above the video; use transform.y to move it (positive = down, in px at project resolution, e.g. y=400 for a lower third at 1080p). Font and color default to the brand kit (set_brand_kit), if one is set.

| Parameter   | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `text`      | string                                   | yes      |                                                                                                                  |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                             | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                  |
| `duration`  | number                                   |          | Seconds (default 3)                                                                                              |
| `trackId`   | string                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `style`     | object                                   |          | fontSize (px), color, backgroundColor, bold, align, …                                                            |
| `transform` | object                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`      | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |

### `add_shape`

**Add shape.** Add a rectangle (optionally rounded) or ellipse as an overlay, e.g. a lower-third bar, a box behind text, a highlight frame (fill null + strokeWidth) or a dot. Sizes are project pixels; it is centered on screen unless transform.x/y move it (offsets from the center, positive y = down). It goes on an overlay track above the video; text added afterwards at the same time stacks above it.

| Parameter      | Type                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`    | string                                   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                           |
| `shape`        | `"rectangle"` \| `"ellipse"`             |          | Default rectangle                                                                                                |
| `start`        | number (≥ 0)                             | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                  |
| `duration`     | number                                   |          | Seconds (default 3)                                                                                              |
| `width`        | number (≤ 16384)                         |          | Pixels (default 400)                                                                                             |
| `height`       | number (≤ 16384)                         |          | Pixels (default 200)                                                                                             |
| `fill`         | string \| null                           |          | Fill color, null for none (default: brand-kit primary color, else #ffffff)                                       |
| `strokeColor`  | string                                   |          | Outline color (default: brand-kit accent color, else #000000)                                                    |
| `strokeWidth`  | number (≥ 0, ≤ 500)                      |          | Outline width in pixels (default 0)                                                                              |
| `cornerRadius` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 8192)                     |          | Rounded corners for rectangles                                                                                   |
| `transform`    | object                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `trackId`      | string                                   |          |                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`         | `"error"` \| `"overwrite"` \| `"insert"` |          | If the range is occupied: "error" (default), "overwrite" existing material, or "insert" (push later clips right) |

### `add_template`

**Add graphics template.** Add ready-made on-screen graphics in one undo step: "title" (big centered heading with accent line, optional subtitle), "lower-third" (name bar at the bottom left, subtitle for role/location), "banner" (full-width bar at the top), "callout" (outlined box with a label to highlight something) or "logo" (the brand-kit logo as an image in a corner, by default for the whole timeline; no text needed). Built from shapes, text and images, so every part can be edited afterwards. Colors and fonts come from the brand kit (set_brand_kit) unless accentColor/textColor are given.

| Parameter     | Type                                                                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `template`    | `"title"` \| `"lower-third"` \| `"banner"` \| `"callout"` \| `"logo"` | yes      | title: big centered heading; lower-third: name bar at the bottom left; banner: full-width bar at the top; callout: outlined box with a label; logo: the brand-kit logo in a corner (set it with set_brand_kit first) |
| `text`        | string                                                                |          | Main text (heading, name, banner text, label); required except for logo                                                                                                                                              |
| `subtitle`    | string                                                                |          | Second line (title subtitle, lower-third role)                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `start`       | number (≥ 0)                                                          | yes      | Time in seconds                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `duration`    | number                                                                |          | Seconds (default 4; logo: until the end of the timeline)                                                                                                                                                             |
| `accentColor` | string                                                                |          | Bar / outline color (default: brand-kit primary or accent color, else #2563eb)                                                                                                                                       |
| `textColor`   | string                                                                |          | Text color (default: brand-kit text color, else #ffffff)                                                                                                                                                             |
| `position`    | `"top-left"` \| `"top-right"` \| `"bottom-left"` \| `"bottom-right"`  |          | logo only: corner (default: brand-kit logoPosition, else top-right)                                                                                                                                                  |
| `projectId`   | string                                                                |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                                                                                                                               |

### `set_brand_kit`

**Set brand kit.** Define the project brand kit once: colors (primary = bars and shape fills, accent = lines and outlines, text = default text color, secondary, background; #RRGGBB), fontFamily (body text), headingFontFamily (titles, names, banners) and a logo (logoAssetId of an imported image, logoPosition corner). Call once, then add_template / add_text_overlay / add_shape pick up these colors and fonts automatically unless you pass explicit ones, and add_template { template: "logo" } places the logo in its corner for the whole video. Only the fields you pass change; null clears a field, reset=true starts over.

| Parameter           | Type                                                                         | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `colors`            | object                                                                       |          | Brand colors to set (#RRGGBB); null clears one                         |
| `fontFamily`        | string \| null                                                               |          | Body font family, e.g. "Georgia, serif"; null clears it                |
| `headingFontFamily` | string \| null                                                               |          | Heading font family (default: fontFamily); null clears it              |
| `logoAssetId`       | string \| null                                                               |          | Image asset to use as logo; null clears                                |
| `logoPosition`      | `"top-left"` \| `"top-right"` \| `"bottom-left"` \| `"bottom-right"` \| null |          | Logo corner; null clears                                               |
| `reset`             | boolean                                                                      |          | Clear the whole brand kit before applying                              |
| `projectId`         | string                                                                       |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |

### `add_captions`

**Add captions.** Add subtitles on a caption track. Either pass cues [{start, end, text}] in timeline seconds, or set fromTranscript=true to transcribe the current timeline audio (speech-to-text, word timings) and generate readable cues automatically — the usual choice for "add captions". Replaces existing captions on the track unless replace=false.

| Parameter        | Type                  | Required | Description                                                               |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`      | string                |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.    |
| `cues`           | object[]              |          |                                                                           |
| `fromTranscript` | boolean               |          | Generate cues from the timeline transcript                                |
| `language`       | string                |          | Spoken language for transcription, e.g. "en", "de" (default: auto-detect) |
| `maxChars`       | integer (≥ 10, ≤ 120) |          | Max characters per cue (default 42)                                       |
| `style`          | object                |          |                                                                           |
| `replace`        | boolean               |          |                                                                           |
| `trackId`        | string                |          |                                                                           |

### `add_transition`

**Add transition.** Add a transition INTO a clip from the clip right before it on the same track: "crossfade" (dissolve, centered on the cut) or "dipToBlack". Without a preceding clip it fades in from transparent. type "none" removes it. Audio follows the transition.

| Parameter   | Type                                        | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                      |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string                                      | yes      | The clip the transition leads into                                     |
| `type`      | `"crossfade"` \| `"dipToBlack"` \| `"none"` | yes      |                                                                        |
| `duration`  | number (≤ 10)                               |          | Seconds (default 1)                                                    |

### `set_audio_volume`

**Set audio volume.** Set the volume (linear gain: 0 = silent, 1 = unchanged, 2 ≈ +6 dB), mute, or fades of a clip, or the volume/mute of a whole track. Give exactly one of clipId or trackId.

| Parameter   | Type               | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string             |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipId`    | string             |          |                                                                        |
| `trackId`   | string             |          |                                                                        |
| `volume`    | number (≥ 0, ≤ 4)  |          |                                                                        |
| `muted`     | boolean            |          |                                                                        |
| `fadeIn`    | number (≥ 0, ≤ 60) |          | Seconds (clips only)                                                   |
| `fadeOut`   | number (≥ 0, ≤ 60) |          | Seconds (clips only)                                                   |

### `apply_operations`

**Apply operations.** Apply a batch of low-level operations atomically as ONE undo step (all or nothing). Covers everything the editor UI can do, including tracks (add_track, update_track: name/mute/hide/lock/volume/captionStyle, remove_track, move_track), project settings (update_project), and remove_asset, plus all clip operations. Use the dedicated tools for single edits.

| Parameter    | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`  | string   |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `operations` | object[] | yes      |                                                                        |
| `label`      | string   |          | Name of the undo step                                                  |

### `undo`

**Undo.** Undo the most recent change to the project, whoever made it (you or the human in the editor).

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |

### `redo`

**Redo.** Redo the change that was last undone (by you or by the human in the editor).

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |

## Perception

### `get_transcript`

**Get transcript.** Speech-to-text of the edited timeline (default) or of one asset, with timestamps in seconds. format "segments" (default) returns sentence-like lines with start/end; "words" adds word-level timings (use them to cut precisely, e.g. remove filler words with delete_range); "text" returns plain text. Uses local Whisper; results are cached per asset.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                                  | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                                |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `language`  | string                                |          | e.g. "en", "de" (default: auto-detect)                                                        |
| `format`    | `"segments"` \| `"words"` \| `"text"` |          |                                                                                               |

### `get_frames`

**Get frames.** Look at the video: returns JPEG thumbnails of the composited timeline (all layers, text and captions) at evenly spaced times between start and end, or at explicit times. With assetId, returns frames of that source file instead.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                   | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                 |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                 |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)           |          | Default 0                                                                                     |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)           |          | Default: end of timeline / asset                                                              |
| `count`     | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 24)    |          | Number of frames (default 6)                                                                  |
| `times`     | number[]               |          | Exact times instead of start/end/count                                                        |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 64, ≤ 1280) |          | Thumbnail width in px (default 320)                                                           |

### `detect_silence`

**Detect silence.** Find pauses in the edited timeline audio (default) or in one asset. Returns silent ranges in seconds, already shrunk by `padding` so cuts keep a natural breath. To remove them, pass `ranges` straight to delete_range. Tune thresholdDb (-50 = only near-digital silence, -30 = also quiet room noise).

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter     | Type                  | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------- | --------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string                |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`     | string                |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `thresholdDb` | number (≥ -90, ≤ -10) |          | RMS level counted as silence (default -40 dBFS)                                               |
| `minDuration` | number (≥ 0.05, ≤ 60) |          | Ignore shorter pauses (default 0.5s)                                                          |
| `padding`     | number (≥ 0, ≤ 2)     |          | Audio kept on each side (default 0.15s)                                                       |

### `detect_scenes`

**Detect scenes.** Find shot changes (visual cuts) in the timeline video (default) or in one asset. Returns cut times in seconds; for the timeline, also the clip boundaries (edits that already exist).

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                   | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                 |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string                 |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `threshold` | number (≥ 0.05, ≤ 0.9) |          | Scene change sensitivity, lower = more cuts (default 0.3)                                     |

### `get_waveform_summary`

**Get waveform summary.** Loudness overview of the timeline audio (default) or one asset: overall peak/RMS in dBFS and per-bucket levels, plus the loudest and quietest parts. Useful to spot music, speech, silence or clipping without listening.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                 | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string               |          | Project id (default: active project)                                                          |
| `assetId`   | string               |          | Analyse one source asset (source time) instead of the edited timeline (default: the timeline) |
| `buckets`   | integer (≥ 4, ≤ 200) |          | Number of time buckets (default 40)                                                           |

## Music

### `detect_beats`

**Detect beats.** Find the tempo (BPM) and beat times of music. Pass assetId (beats in source time) or clipId (also returns timelineBeats: where the beats fall on the timeline within that clip); default: the first clip on an audio track. downbeats are likely bar starts (assumes 4/4), included only when clear. Results are cached per asset. To cut visuals to the music, use cut_to_beats.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                 | Required | Description                            |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string               |          | Project id (default: active project)   |
| `assetId`   | string               |          | Analyse this asset                     |
| `clipId`    | string               |          | Analyse the media under this clip      |
| `minBpm`    | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) |          | Slowest tempo considered (default 60)  |
| `maxBpm`    | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) |          | Fastest tempo considered (default 200) |

### `cut_to_beats`

**Cut to the beat.** Lay visual clips back-to-back so every cut lands on a beat of the music. Clips keep their in-points and are trimmed (or extended, if media remains) to span everyNBeats beats each, starting where the first clip starts now; a clip whose media runs out spans fewer whole beats. Default clips: those on the main (lowest) video track, in timeline order. Default music: the first clip on an audio track. One undo step.

| Parameter     | Type                 | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId`   | string               |          | Project id (default: active project)                                   |
| `musicClipId` | string               |          | Clip whose music sets the beat (default: first clip on an audio track) |
| `clipIds`     | string[]             |          | Visual clips to lay out, in this order (default: main video track)     |
| `everyNBeats` | number               |          | Beats per clip (default 4 = one bar in 4/4)                            |
| `minBpm`      | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) |          | Slowest tempo considered (default 60)                                  |
| `maxBpm`      | number (≥ 30, ≤ 300) |          | Fastest tempo considered (default 200)                                 |

## Audio

### `duck_music`

**Duck music under speech.** Make the music quieter automatically while someone speaks (auto-ducking). Finds speech on the voice track(s) — from a cached transcript if one exists, otherwise from loudness (non-silent ranges) — and stores a smooth volume envelope on the music clips (one undo step). Running it again replaces the previous ducking; amountDb 0 effectively removes it. Tracks are picked automatically when omitted (music = the track named like music, or the only audio track next to a video with sound).

| Parameter      | Type                                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `projectId`    | string                                    |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently.                                                                           |
| `musicTrackId` | string                                    |          | Track to make quieter (default: auto-detect)                                                                                                     |
| `voiceTrackId` | string                                    |          | Track with speech (default: every other audible track)                                                                                           |
| `amountDb`     | number (≥ -60, ≤ 0)                       |          | Volume change while speech is heard, dB (default -12)                                                                                            |
| `attack`       | number (≥ 0.01, ≤ 5)                      |          | Seconds to fade the music down before speech (default 0.15)                                                                                      |
| `release`      | number (≥ 0.01, ≤ 10)                     |          | Seconds to fade the music back up after speech (default 0.4)                                                                                     |
| `source`       | `"auto"` \| `"silence"` \| `"transcript"` |          | "silence" = loudness only, "transcript" = word timings (transcribes if needed), "auto" (default) = cached transcript if available, else loudness |
| `thresholdDb`  | number (≥ -90, ≤ -10)                     |          | Voice level counted as silence for loudness detection (default -40 dBFS)                                                                         |

### `normalize_loudness`

**Normalize loudness.** Measure the loudness (EBU R128 integrated LUFS and true peak, via ffmpeg) of audio/video clips and set each clip volume so it plays at the target loudness: -14 LUFS (default) suits YouTube/social, -16 podcasts, -23 broadcast. Gain is capped so the true peak stays below truePeak and the volume at most ×4 (+12 dB); such clips are reported as limited. Without clipIds/trackId all clips on unlocked tracks are normalized. One undo step; measurements are cached per asset.

| Parameter   | Type                 | Required | Description                                                            |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string               |          | Project id. Omit to use the project you created or used most recently. |
| `clipIds`   | string[]             |          |                                                                        |
| `trackId`   | string               |          |                                                                        |
| `target`    | number (≥ -40, ≤ -5) |          | Integrated loudness target in LUFS (default -14)                       |
| `truePeak`  | number (≥ -10, ≤ 0)  |          | True-peak ceiling in dBTP (default -1)                                 |

## Output

### `render_preview`

**Render preview.** Quickly render a low-resolution MP4 of the timeline (or a range) to check timing and sound. Returns a URL the user can open and the file path. Use get_frames to look at stills yourself.

_Annotations: readOnly_

| Parameter   | Type                    | Required | Description                          |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `projectId` | string                  |          | Project id (default: active project) |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)            |          | Time in seconds                      |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)            |          | Time in seconds                      |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 160, ≤ 1280) |          | Default 640                          |

### `export_video`

**Export video.** Render the final MP4 (H.264/AAC) on the server with ffmpeg. Returns a download URL and the file path. Quality: "draft" (fast), "standard" (default), "high" (slow, best). The user can also export in the browser from the Export dialog.

| Parameter   | Type                                  | Required | Description                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `projectId` | string                                |          | Project id (default: active project)     |
| `quality`   | `"draft"` \| `"standard"` \| `"high"` |          |                                          |
| `width`     | integer (≥ 160, ≤ 7680)               |          | Default: project width                   |
| `fps`       | number (≤ 120)                        |          | Default: project fps                     |
| `start`     | number (≥ 0)                          |          | Time in seconds                          |
| `end`       | number (≥ 0)                          |          | Time in seconds                          |
| `fileName`  | string                                |          | File name prefix (default: project name) |

Batch them with `apply_operations` to make several changes as one undo step.
